selected_items.description: Delete personnel record with vector embedding cleanup, storage cleanup, and Detection record preservation (sets personnel_id to NULL on human_logs). Returns 204 No Content.
Multiple-image upload with face enrollment, optional cropping, is_primary support, batch transaction, and per-image cleanup.
Delete personnel image with vector embedding cleanup, storage file cleanup, and automatic primary promotion. Returns 204 No Content.

prompt_enrichment.DELETE_response: 204 No Content instead of 200 JSON body
prompt_enrichment.vector_cleanup: delete_point() called on face vector store for each removed embedding
prompt_enrichment.storage_cleanup: Physical image files deleted from personnel_snapshots/
prompt_enrichment.detection_preservation: human_logs.personnel_id set to NULL before personnel delete
prompt_enrichment.primary_promotion: Automatic when deleted image was primary
prompt_enrichment.is_primary_parameter: Form parameter on POST upload; True=force primary, False=force non-primary, None=auto (first or if no primary exists)

safe_assumptions: SQlite ON DELETE CASCADE handles personnel_images record cleanup when personnel is deleted
human_logs.personnel_id is nullable (INTEGER without NOT NULL constraint)
Face vector store delete_point() exists on both QdrantFaceStore and SqliteFaceStore
Mock mode has face_processor = MockProcessor; _face_processor(runtime) returns None
Vector cleanup errors are non-fatal (logged as warning)
204 No Content response with empty body is the correct REST convention for DELETE
is_primary=True on batch upload: last processed image ends up as primary (atomic unset+set per image)
